finalReport.interpretation: Observational only. Baseline eligibility is not delivery. Feedback concerns existing replies, not shadow actions. Compute time excludes log IO and model latency. Short aside gaps include reminders; they are not automatically unwanted interruptions.

limitations: Point-in-time health checks; faults between observations are not directly observed
Final report counters are cumulative; snapshots have not been summed
Idle and focus refer to the server OS, not the user desktop or phone
